title: Fix Aggregator Inactive Fill Ticks
description: Aggregator must advance fill background planning only while the mode-level fill tool is active. Ignore stale or queued fillBuildTick actions after the tool is deactivated.
summary: Stopped Aggregator fill planning after the mode-level Fill tool is deactivated. fillBuildTick now checks the authoritative ViewState.active_tool_id before advancing PrecomputeLane::Fill; stale or queued ticks return UiDirtyScope::None and leave fill progress unchanged. Added a regression exercising 64 stale ticks after deactivation. Verified all 136 Puzzle 3D engine and UI tests, runtime progress remaining unchanged, and the workspace verify gate.
